newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia growth put at 6.9 pct in 96, 5.7 pct in 97.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia growth put at 6.9 pct in 96, 5.7 pct in 97.

text.p: Tunisia's real gross domestic product (GDP) growth rate is estimated at 6.9 percent in 1996 after 2.4 percent last year, budget reports showed on Monday.
The reports, obtained by Reuters, also showed that the government forecasts a GDP growth rate of 5.7 percent for 1997.

The 1996 figure is down from an October forecast of 7.5 to eight percent based on a much more optimistic estimate of the cereals crop. But the figure remains higher than an earlier budget forecast of 6.7 percent.
The reports said that the high growth rate was made possible by a record cereals crop estimated at 2.8 million tonnes this year.
Owing to two consecutive years of drought, the GDP rate was 3.3 percent at constant prices in 1994.
